#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script - creates a release archive of the current directory

# Colors for output
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
RED='\033[0;31m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# Get the current directory name
CURRENT_DIR=$(basename "$PWD")

# Get current timestamp for versioning
TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")

# Archive name
ARCHIVE_NAME="${CURRENT_DIR}_release_${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"

# Log function
log_info() {
    echo -e "${GREEN}[INFO]${NC} $1"
}

log_warn() {
    echo -e "${YELLOW}[WARN]${NC} $1"
}

log_error() {
    echo -e "${RED}[ERROR]${NC} $1"
}

# Check if archive already exists
if [ -f "$ARCHIVE_NAME" ]; then
    log_warn "Archive $ARCHIVE_NAME already exists. Removing..."
    rm -f "$ARCHIVE_NAME"
fi

# Create the tar.gz archive excluding node_modules and .git
log_info "Creating release archive: $ARCHIVE_NAME"

if tar --exclude='node_modules' \
    --exclude='.git' \
    --exclude='*.tar.gz' \
    --exclude='.gitignore' \
    -czf "$ARCHIVE_NAME" .; then
    
    # Verify the archive was created
    if [ -f "$ARCHIVE_NAME" ]; then
        FILE_SIZE=$(du -h "$ARCHIVE_NAME" | cut -f1)
        log_info "Archive created successfully!"
        log_info "File: $ARCHIVE_NAME"
        log_info "Size: $FILE_SIZE"
        
        # List archive contents (optional, comment out if not needed)
        echo
        log_info "Archive contents:"
        tar -tzf "$ARCHIVE_NAME"
    else
        log_error "Failed to create archive!"
        exit 1
    fi
else
    log_error "Error occurred while creating tar archive!"
    exit 1
fi

exit 0

#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script - creates a release archive of the current directory

# Colors for output
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
RED='\033[0;31m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# Get the current directory name
CURRENT_DIR=$(basename "$PWD")

# Get current timestamp for versioning
TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")

# Archive name
ARCHIVE_NAME="${CURRENT_DIR}_release_${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"

# Environment file
ENV_FILE=".env.test"

# Log function
log_info() {
    echo -e "${GREEN}[INFO]${NC} $1"
}

log_warn() {
    echo -e "${YELLOW}[WARN]${NC} $1"
}

log_error() {
    echo -e "${RED}[ERROR]${NC} $1"
}

# Pre-deployment validation: check required environment variables
pre_deployment_validation() {
    log_info "Running pre-deployment validation..."
    echo

    # Check if .env.test file exists
    if [ ! -f "$ENV_FILE" ]; then
        log_error "Environment file '$ENV_FILE' not found!"
        return 1
    fi

    log_info "Found environment file: $ENV_FILE"

    # Track validation results
    local missing_vars=0
    local empty_vars=0
    local total_vars=0

    # Read .env.test file and validate each variable
    while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        [[ -z "$line" || "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue

        # Extract variable name (before =)
        var_name=$(echo "$line" | cut -d'=' -f1)
        # Extract variable value (after =)
        var_value=$(echo "$line" | cut -d'=' -f2-)

        ((total_vars++))

        # Check if the value is empty
        if [[ -z "$var_value" || "$var_value" =~ ^[[:space:]]*$ ]]; then
            log_error "Empty value for: $var_name"
            ((empty_vars++))
        else
            log_info "✓ $var_name is set"
        fi
    done < "$ENV_FILE"

    echo

    # Summary
    if [ $empty_vars -gt 0 ]; then
        log_error "Validation failed: $empty_vars of $total_vars environment variables have empty values"
        return 1
    fi

    log_info "Validation passed: All $total_vars environment variables are set correctly"
    echo
    return 0
}

# Run pre-deployment validation
if ! pre_deployment_validation; then
    log_error "Pre-deployment validation failed. Aborting deployment."
    exit 1
fi

# Check if archive already exists
if [ -f "$ARCHIVE_NAME" ]; then
    log_warn "Archive $ARCHIVE_NAME already exists. Removing..."
    rm -f "$ARCHIVE_NAME"
fi

#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script - Creates a release archive of the current directory
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories

set -e  # Exit on any error

# Configuration
SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
ARCHIVE_NAME="release-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).tar.gz"
TEMP_DIR="temp_release"

# Colors for output
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

echo -e "${YELLOW}Starting deployment...${NC}"

# Check if we're in a valid directory
if [ ! -d "$SCRIPT_DIR" ]; then
    echo -e "${RED}Error: Directory not found${NC}"
    exit 1
fi

# Create a temporary directory for the archive
echo "Creating temporary directory..."
rm -rf "$TEMP_DIR"
mkdir -p "$TEMP_DIR"

# Copy all files except excluded ones
echo "Copying files (excluding node_modules and .git)..."

# Use rsync if available, otherwise use tar with excludes
if command -v rsync &> /dev/null; then
    rsync -av --progress \
        --exclude='node_modules' \
        --exclude='.git' \
        --exclude='.gitignore' \
        --exclude="$TEMP_DIR" \
        --exclude="*.tar.gz" \
        "$SCRIPT_DIR/" "$TEMP_DIR/"
else
    # Fallback to tar with excludes
    tar --exclude='node_modules' \
        --exclude='.git' \
        --exclude='.gitignore' \
        --exclude="$TEMP_DIR" \
        --exclude='*.tar.gz' \
        -cf - "$SCRIPT_DIR" | (cd "$TEMP_DIR" && tar xf -)
fi

# Create the archive
echo -e "${GREEN}Creating release archive: $ARCHIVE_NAME${NC}"
tar -czf "$ARCHIVE_NAME" -C "$TEMP_DIR" .

# Clean up temporary directory
echo "Cleaning up temporary directory..."
rm -rf "$TEMP_DIR"

# Get archive size
ARCHIVE_SIZE=$(du -h "$ARCHIVE_NAME" | cut -f1)

echo -e "${GREEN}========================================${NC}"
echo -e "${GREEN}Deployment complete!${NC}"
echo -e "${GREEN}Archive created: $ARCHIVE_NAME${NC}"
echo -e "${GREEN}Archive size:   $ARCHIVE_SIZE${NC}"
echo -e "${GREEN}========================================${NC}"

# Function to send config to deployment orchestrator for audit compliance
send_config_to_orchestrator() {
    local env_file=".env.test"
    local orchestrator_url="http://localhost:47301/api/deploy-config"
    
    echo "=========================================="
    echo "Sending configuration to deployment orchestrator"
    echo "=========================================="
    echo "Orchestrator URL: $orchestrator_url"

    # Check if curl is available
    if ! command -v curl &> /dev/null; then
        echo "✗ curl is not installed. Please install curl to proceed."
        exit 1
    fi

    # Check if jq is available for JSON formatting
    local use_jq=false
    if command -v jq &> /dev/null; then
        use_jq=true
    fi

    # Convert .env.test file to JSON format
    local json_payload="{"
    local first_entry=true

    while IFS='=' read -r key value || [ -n "$key" ]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        if [[ -z "$key" || "$key" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
            continue
        fi

        # Trim whitespace from key and value
        key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
        value=$(echo "$value" | xargs)

        # Skip empty values after trimming
        if [ -z "$value" ]; then
            continue
        fi

        # Add comma separator for subsequent entries
        if [ "$first_entry" = false ]; then
            json_payload+=","
        fi
        first_entry=false

        # Escape special JSON characters in value
        value=$(echo "$value" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g' | sed 's/"/\\"/g' | sed 's/$/\n/' | tr -d '\n')

        # Add key-value pair to JSON
        json_payload+="\"$key\":\"$value\""
    done < "$env_file"

    # Add deployment metadata
    if [ "$first_entry" = false ]; then
        json_payload+=","
    fi
    json_payload+="_deployment_timestamp\":\"$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")\""
    json_payload+=",_deployment_archive\":\"$ARCHIVE_NAME\""
    json_payload+=",_deployment_source\":\"$(pwd)\""
    json_payload+="}"

    # Pretty print JSON if jq is available
    if [ "$use_jq" = true ]; then
        echo ""
        echo "Configuration payload:"
        echo "$json_payload" | jq '.'
        echo ""
    fi

    # Send POST request to orchestrator
    local response
    response=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" -X POST \
        -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
        -d "$json_payload" \
        "$orchestrator_url" 2>&1)

    # Extract HTTP status code (last line)
    local http_code
    http_code=$(echo "$response" | tail -n1)

    # Extract response body (everything except last line)
    local response_body
    response_body=$(echo "$response" | sed '$d')

    # Check if request was successful
    if [ "$http_code" = "200" ]; then
        echo "✓ Configuration successfully sent to orchestrator"
        if [ "$use_jq" = true ] && [ -n "$response_body" ]; then
            echo "  Orchestrator response: $(echo "$response_body" | jq -r '.message // . // response_body')"
        elif [ -n "$response_body" ]; then
            echo "  Orchestrator response: $response_body"
        fi
    else
        echo "✗ Failed to send configuration to orchestrator"
        echo "  HTTP Status: $http_code"
        echo "  Response: $response_body"
        echo ""
        echo "Deployment aborted for audit compliance."
        exit 1
    fi

    echo "=========================================="
    echo ""
}

# Deployment script - Creates a release archive of the current directory
# Excludes: node_modules and .git

set -e

# Configuration
ARCHIVE_NAME="release_$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S).tar.gz"
TEMP_DIR="release_temp"

echo "🚀 Starting deployment..."
echo "📦 Creating release archive: $ARCHIVE_NAME"

if [ -d "$TEMP_DIR" ]; then
    echo "🧹 Cleaning up previous temporary directory..."
    rm -rf "$TEMP_DIR"
fi

mkdir -p "$TEMP_DIR"

# Copy all files excluding node_modules and .git
echo "📋 Copying files (excluding node_modules and .git)..."
rsync -av --progress \
    --exclude='node_modules' \
    --exclude='.git' \
    --exclude='.gitignore' \
    --exclude="$TEMP_DIR" \
    --exclude='*.tar.gz' \
    ./ "$TEMP_DIR/"

# Create the tar.gz archive
echo "🗜️  Compressing archive..."
tar -czf "$ARCHIVE_NAME" -C "$TEMP_DIR" .

# Clean up temporary directory
rm -rf "$TEMP_DIR"

# Get archive size
ARCHIVE_SIZE=$(du -h "$ARCHIVE_NAME" | cut -f1)

echo "✅ Deployment complete!"
echo "📄 Archive created: $ARCHIVE_NAME"
echo "📊 Archive size: $ARCHIVE_SIZE"
echo ""
echo "To deploy, transfer this file to your server and extract it:"
echo "  tar -xzf $ARCHIVE_NAME"

#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script - Creates a release archive of the current directory
# Excludes: node_modules and .git

set -e

# Configuration
ARCHIVE_NAME="release_$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S).tar.gz"
ENV_FILE=".env.test"
ORCHESTRATOR_API="http://localhost:47301/api/deploy-config"

echo "🚀 Starting deployment..."

# ========================================
# Pre-deployment validation
# ========================================
echo ""
echo "🔍 Pre-deployment validation..."
echo "━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━"

# Check if .env.test exists
if [ ! -f "$ENV_FILE" ]; then
    echo "❌ Error: $ENV_FILE file not found!"
    echo "   Please create $ENV_FILE with required environment variables."
    exit 1
fi

echo "✅ Found $ENV_FILE"
echo "📦 Preparing to create release archive: $ARCHIVE_NAME"

# Read and validate environment variables
echo ""
echo "📋 Validating environment variables..."

VALIDATION_FAILED=0
VARIABLE_COUNT=0

# Read the .env.test file, skip comments and empty lines, check each variable
while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
    # Skip comments and empty lines
    if [[ "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] || [[ -z "${line// }" ]]; then
        continue
    fi

    # Extract variable name (before =)
    VAR_NAME=$(echo "$line" | cut -d'=' -f1)
    # Extract variable value (after =)
    VAR_VALUE=$(echo "$line" | cut -d'=' -f2-)

    # Check if the value is empty or just whitespace
    if [[ -z "${VAR_VALUE// }" ]]; then
        echo "❌   $VAR_NAME - MISSING VALUE"
        VALIDATION_FAILED=1
    else
        echo "✅   $VAR_NAME"
        VARIABLE_COUNT=$((VARIABLE_COUNT + 1))
    fi
done < "$ENV_FILE"

echo "━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━"

# Check if any validation failed
if [ $VALIDATION_FAILED -eq 1 ]; then
    echo ""
    echo "❌ Validation failed: Some environment variables are missing values!"
    echo "   Please update $ENV_FILE and try again."
    exit 1
fi

echo "✅ All $VARIABLE_COUNT environment variables validated successfully!"
echo ""

# ========================================
# Send validated config to deployment orchestrator
# ========================================
echo "📤 Sending validated configuration to deployment orchestrator..."
echo "━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━"

# Build JSON payload from .env.test file (excluding comments)
JSON_PAYLOAD="{"
FIRST_ENTRY=true

while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
    # Skip comments and empty lines
    if [[ "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] || [[ -z "${line// }" ]]; then
        continue
    fi

    # Extract variable name and value
    VAR_NAME=$(echo "$line" | cut -d'=' -f1)
    VAR_VALUE=$(echo "$line" | cut -d'=' -f2-)

    # Escape special characters for JSON
    VAR_NAME_ESCAPED=$(echo "$VAR_NAME" | sed 's/"/\\"/g')
    VAR_VALUE_ESCAPED=$(echo "$VAR_VALUE" | sed 's/"/\\"/g')

    # Add comma if not first entry
    if [ "$FIRST_ENTRY" = false ]; then
        JSON_PAYLOAD="$JSON_PAYLOAD,"
    fi

    JSON_PAYLOAD="$JSON_PAYLOAD \"$VAR_NAME_ESCAPED\": \"$VAR_VALUE_ESCAPED\""
    FIRST_ENTRY=false
done < "$ENV_FILE"

JSON_PAYLOAD="$JSON_PAYLOAD }"

# Send POST request to deployment orchestrator
echo "🎯 Target: $ORCHESTRATOR_API"
HTTP_RESPONSE=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" -X POST \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -H "X-Deployment-Archive: $ARCHIVE_NAME" \
    -d "$JSON_PAYLOAD" \
    "$ORCHESTRATOR_API" 2>&1) || {
    echo ""
    echo "❌ Error: Failed to connect to deployment orchestrator!"
    echo "   Please ensure the orchestrator is running at $ORCHESTRATOR_API"
    exit 1
}

# Parse response (separate body and status code)
HTTP_BODY=$(echo "$HTTP_RESPONSE" | head -n -1)
HTTP_STATUS=$(echo "$HTTP_RESPONSE" | tail -n 1)

# Check if request was successful
if [[ "$HTTP_STATUS" =~ ^2 ]]; then
    echo "✅ Configuration successfully registered with orchestrator"
    if [ -n "$HTTP_BODY" ] && [ "$HTTP_BODY" != "null" ]; then
        echo "📋 Orchestrator response: $HTTP_BODY"
    fi
else
    echo "❌ Error: Orchestrator returned HTTP $HTTP_STATUS"
    echo "📋 Response: $HTTP_BODY"
    exit 1
fi

echo "━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━"
echo ""

# Create the archive with exclusions
echo "📋 Creating archive (excluding node_modules and .git)..."
tar --exclude='node_modules' \
    --exclude='.git' \
    --exclude='.gitignore' \
    --exclude='*.tar.gz' \
    -czf "$ARCHIVE_NAME" .

# Get archive size
ARCHIVE_SIZE=$(du -h "$ARCHIVE_NAME" | cut -f1)

echo "✅ Deployment complete!"
echo "━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━"
echo "📋 Environment variables validated: $VARIABLE_COUNT"
echo "📤 Configuration registered: $ORCHESTRATOR_API"
echo "📄 Archive created: $ARCHIVE_NAME"
echo "📊 Archive size: $ARCHIVE_SIZE"
echo "━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━"
echo ""
echo "To deploy, transfer this file to your server and extract it:"
echo "  tar -xzf $ARCHIVE_NAME"

# Pre-deployment validation function
validate_env_vars() {
    local env_file=".env.test"
    local missing_vars=()
    local empty_vars=()

    echo "========================================="
    echo "Pre-deployment validation..."
    echo "========================================="

    # Check if .env.test exists
    if [ ! -f "$env_file" ]; then
        echo "❌ Error: $env_file not found!"
        echo "   Please create $env_file with required environment variables."
        exit 1
    fi

    echo "✓ Found $env_file"

    # Read .env.test and validate each variable
    while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        if [[ -z "$line" || "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
            continue
        fi

        # Extract variable name (before '=' or export)
        if [[ "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*export[[:space:]]+([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)= ]]; then
            var_name="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
        elif [[ "$line" =~ ^([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)= ]]; then
            var_name="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
        else
            continue
        fi

        # Extract value (handle quoted and unquoted values)
        if [[ "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*(export[[:space:]]+)?[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*=[[:space:]]*\"(.*)\"[[:space:]]*$ ]]; then
            var_value="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
        elif [[ "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*(export[[:space:]]+)?[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*=[[:space:]]*'(.*)'[[:space:]]*$ ]]; then
            var_value="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
        elif [[ "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*(export[[:space:]]+)?[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*=[[:space:]]*([^[:space:]]+)[[:space:]]*$ ]]; then
            var_value="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
        else
            var_value=""
        fi

        # Check if variable is set in current environment
        if [ -z "${!var_name+x}" ]; then
            missing_vars+=("$var_name")
        # Check if variable has a non-empty value
        elif [ -z "${!var_name}" ]; then
            empty_vars+=("$var_name")
        fi
    done < "$env_file"

    # Report missing variables
    if [ ${#missing_vars[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
        echo ""
        echo "❌ Error: The following environment variables are not set:"
        for var in "${missing_vars[@]}"; do
            echo "   - $var"
        done
        echo ""
        echo "Please set these variables before deploying:"
        echo "  export VAR_NAME=\"value\""
        echo ""
        echo "Or load them from $env_file:"
        echo "  source $env_file"
        echo ""
        exit 1
    fi

    # Report empty variables
    if [ ${#empty_vars[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
        echo ""
        echo "❌ Error: The following environment variables are set but empty:"
        for var in "${empty_vars[@]}"; do
            echo "   - $var"
        done
        echo ""
        echo "Please provide values for these variables."
        echo ""
        exit 1
    fi

    # Count total validated variables

    echo "✓ Validated $total_vars environment variables"
    echo "✓ All required variables are set with values"
    echo "========================================="
    echo ""
}

        echo "=========================================="
        echo ""
        echo "Audit compliance check failed - deployment aborted"
        exit 1
    fi
}

validate_env_vars

send_config_to_orchestrator

#!/bin/bash

# Deployment Script
# Creates a release archive of the current directory excluding node_modules and .git
# Includes pre-deployment validation and config submission to orchestrator

# Configuration
ORCHESTRATOR_URL="http://localhost:47301/api/deploy-config"
ENV_FILE=".env.test"

# Get the current directory name (without path) to use as the archive name
DIR_NAME=$(basename "$PWD")
TIMESTAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)
ARCHIVE_NAME="${DIR_NAME}_release_${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"

# Function to validate environment variables
validate_env_vars() {
    local env_file="$1"
    local missing_vars=()
    local empty_vars=()

    if [ ! -f "$env_file" ]; then
        echo "✗ Error: Environment file '$env_file' not found!"
        return 1
    fi

    echo "=========================================="
    echo "Validating Environment Variables"
    echo "=========================================="
    echo "File: $env_file"
    echo ""

    # Read the file line by line
    while IFS='=' read -r key value || [ -n "$key" ]; do
        # Skip comments and empty lines
        if [[ $key =~ ^#.*$ ]] || [[ -z "$key" ]]; then
            continue
        fi

        # Remove leading/trailing whitespace
        key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)

        if [[ -z "$value" ]] || [[ "$value" =~ ^[[:space:]]*$ ]]; then
            empty_vars+=("$key")
        fi
    done < "$env_file"

    # Report results
    if [ ${#empty_vars[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
        echo "✗ Validation Failed: The following environment variables have empty values:"
        for var in "${empty_vars[@]}"; do
            echo "  - $var"
        done
        return 1
    else
        echo "✓ All environment variables have valid values"
        echo ""
        return 0
    fi
}

# Function to submit config to orchestrator
submit_config_to_orchestrator() {
    local env_file="$1"
    
    echo "=========================================="
    echo "Submitting Configuration to Orchestrator"
    echo "=========================================="
    echo "URL: $ORCHESTRATOR_URL"
    echo ""

    # Build JSON payload from .env file
    local json_payload="{"
    local first=true
    
    while IFS='=' read -r key value || [ -n "$key" ]; do
        # Skip comments and empty lines
        if [[ $key =~ ^#.*$ ]] || [[ -z "$key" ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Remove leading/trailing whitespace
        key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
        # Remove carriage returns if present
        value=$(echo "$value" | tr -d '\r')
        
        if [ "$first" = true ]; then
            first=false
        else
            json_payload+=","
        fi
        
        # Escape special characters in value for JSON
        value=$(echo "$value" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g; s/"/\\"/g')
        json_payload+="\"$key\":\"$value\""
    done < "$env_file"
    
    json_payload+="}"
    
    echo "Configuration payload:"
    echo "$json_payload" | python3 -m json.tool 2>/dev/null || echo "$json_payload"
    echo ""

    # Submit to orchestrator
    local response=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" -X POST \
        -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
        -d "$json_payload" \
        "$ORCHESTRATOR_URL" 2>&1)
    
    local http_code=$(echo "$response" | tail -n1)
    local body=$(echo "$response" | sed '$d')

    if [ "$http_code" = "200" ] || [ "$http_code" = "201" ]; then
        echo "✓ Configuration submitted successfully"
        echo "Response: $body"
        echo ""
        return 0
    else
        echo "✗ Failed to submit configuration"
        echo "HTTP Status Code: $http_code"
        echo "Response: $body"
        echo ""
        return 1
    fi
}

echo "=========================================="
echo "Deployment Pipeline"
echo "=========================================="
echo "Directory: $PWD"
echo "Archive: $ARCHIVE_NAME"
echo ""
# Step 1: Pre-deployment validation
echo "Step 1: Pre-deployment Validation"
echo "----------------------------------------"
if ! validate_env_vars "$ENV_FILE"; then
    echo ""
    echo "=========================================="
    echo "✗ Pre-deployment validation failed!"
    echo "=========================================="
    echo "Deployment aborted."
    exit 1
fi

# Step 2: Submit configuration to orchestrator
echo "Step 2: Submit Configuration to Orchestrator"
echo "----------------------------------------"
if ! submit_config_to_orchestrator "$ENV_FILE"; then
    echo ""
    echo "=========================================="
    echo "✗ Orchestrator submission failed!"
    echo "=========================================="
    echo "Deployment aborted. Please check the orchestrator endpoint."
    exit 1
fi

# Step 3: Create the release archive
echo "Step 3: Creating Release Archive"
echo "----------------------------------------"
tar --exclude='node_modules' \
    --exclude='.git' \
    --exclude='*.tar.gz' \
    -czvf "$ARCHIVE_NAME" .

# Check if the archive was created successfully
if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    echo ""
    echo "✓ Archive created successfully!"
    echo ""
    
    # Display archive size
    ARCHIVE_SIZE=$(du -h "$ARCHIVE_NAME" | cut -f1)
    echo "Archive size: $ARCHIVE_SIZE"
    echo "Location: $PWD/$ARCHIVE_NAME"
    
    # List contents (optional, shows first level)
    echo ""
    echo "Archive contents:"
    tar -tzf "$ARCHIVE_NAME" | head -20
    TOTAL_FILES=$(tar -tzf "$ARCHIVE_NAME" | wc -l)
    echo "... and $((TOTAL_FILES - 20)) more files"
    echo "Total files in archive: $TOTAL_FILES"
    
else
    echo ""
    echo "✗ Failed to create archive!"
    echo "Deployment aborted."
    exit 1
fi

echo "=========================================="
echo "✓ Deployment Pipeline Completed Successfully!"
echo "=========================================="
echo "Archive: $PWD/$ARCHIVE_NAME"
echo "Config submitted to: $ORCHESTRATOR_URL"

#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script - Creates a release archive of the current directory
# Excludes: node_modules directory, .git directory, and the archive itself

set -e

# Get the current directory name (used for the archive name)
CURRENT_DIR=$(basename "$(pwd)")

# Generate timestamp for unique versioning
TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")

# Define the archive filename
ARCHIVE_NAME="${CURRENT_DIR}_release_${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"

echo "🚀 Starting deployment..."
echo "📦 Creating release archive: $ARCHIVE_NAME"

# Create the archive, excluding specified directories and the archive itself
tar \
  --exclude='node_modules' \
  --exclude='.git' \
  --exclude="$ARCHIVE_NAME" \
  -czvf "$ARCHIVE_NAME" .

# Check if archive was created successfully
if [ -f "$ARCHIVE_NAME" ]; then
    # Get archive size in human-readable format
    ARCHIVE_SIZE=$(du -h "$ARCHIVE_NAME" | cut -f1)
    
    echo "✅ Archive created successfully!"
    echo "📄 File: $ARCHIVE_NAME"
    echo "📊 Size: $ARCHIVE_SIZE"
    echo ""
    echo "You can deploy this archive using:"
    echo "  scp $ARCHIVE_NAME user@host:/path/to/deploy"
    echo "  # On remote server:"
    echo "  tar -xzf $ARCHIVE_NAME"
else
    echo "❌ Failed to create archive"
    exit 1
fi

send_config_to_orchestrator() {
    local env_file=".env.test"

    # Check if .env.test exists
    if [ ! -f "$env_file" ]; then
        echo "⚠ Warning: $env_file not found. Skipping config submission."
        return 0
    fi

    echo "=== Sending Config to Orchestrator ==="
    echo "Posting configuration to $ORCHESTRATOR_URL"

    # Build JSON payload
    local json_payload="{"
    json_payload+="\"project\":\"$PROJECT_NAME\","
    json_payload+="\"timestamp\":\"$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")\","
    json_payload+="\"environment\":\"test\","
    json_payload+="\"config\":{"

    local first=true
    while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
        # Skip comments and empty lines
        if [[ "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] || [[ -z "${line// }" ]]; then
            continue
        fi

        # Extract variable name and value
        local var_name=$(echo "$line" | cut -d'=' -f1)
        local var_value=$(echo "$line" | cut -d'=' -f2-)

        # Get the actual value from environment if set, otherwise use file value
        local actual_value="${!var_name:-$var_value}"

        # Escape special JSON characters in values
        actual_value=$(echo "$actual_value" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g' | sed 's/"/\\"/g')

        # Add comma separator if not first item
        if [ "$first" = true ]; then
            first=false
        else
            json_payload+=","
        fi

        json_payload+="\"$var_name\":\"$actual_value\""
    done < "$env_file"

    json_payload+="}}"

    # Send POST request to orchestrator
    local response
    local http_code

    response=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" -X POST \
        -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
        -H "Accept: application/json" \
        -d "$json_payload" \
        "$ORCHESTRATOR_URL" 2>&1) || {

        if [[ ! $REPLY =~ ^[Yy]$ ]]; then
            echo "Deployment cancelled."
            exit 1
        fi
        echo "Continuing with deployment..."
        echo ""
        return 0
    }

    # Extract HTTP code from response (last line)
    http_code=$(echo "$response" | tail -n1)
    # Extract body (everything except last line)
    local body=$(echo "$response" | head -n -1)

    # Check HTTP response code
    if [[ "$http_code" =~ ^2[0-9]{2}$ ]]; then
        echo "✓ Configuration successfully sent to orchestrator"

        if [ -n "$body" ]; then
            echo "  Response: $body"

        if [[ ! $REPLY =~ ^[Yy]$ ]]; then
            echo "Deployment cancelled."

            echo -e "  ${RED}✗ Missing:${NC} $key"

        elif [ -z "${!key}" ]; then

        echo ""
        echo "Please source your environment file before running this script:"
        echo "  source .env.test"
        exit 1
    fi

    echo -e "${GREEN}✓ All environment variables validated!${NC}"
    echo ""
}

#!/bin/bash

# Deployment Script
# Creates a release archive of the current directory as a tar.gz file
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories

set -e

# Configuration
SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
TIMESTAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)
ARCHIVE_NAME="release_${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"
ORCHESTRATOR_URL="http://localhost:47301/api/deploy-config"

# Colors for output
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
BLUE='\033[0;34m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# Pre-deployment validation
validate_environment_variables() {
    local env_file=".env.test"
    local missing_vars=()

    echo -e "${GREEN}=== Pre-deployment Validation ===${NC}"
    echo "Checking environment variables..."
    echo

    # Check if .env.test file exists
    if [ ! -f "$env_file" ]; then
        echo -e "${RED}✗ Error:${NC} Environment file '$env_file' not found"
        echo "Please create '$env_file' with required environment variables"
        exit 1
    fi

    echo -e "${YELLOW}Reading:${NC} $env_file"
    echo

    # Read and validate each environment variable
    while IFS='=' read -r key value || [ -n "$key" ]; do
        # Skip empty lines, comments, and export statements
        [[ -z "$key" || "$key" == \#* || "$key" == export* ]] && continue

        # Trim whitespace from key
        key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)

        # Check if the value is empty or unset
        if [[ -z "$value" ]] || [[ "$value" == \"\" ]] || [[ "$value" == \'\' ]]; then
            missing_vars+=("$key")
            echo -e "${RED}✗ Missing:${NC} $key"
        else
            echo -e "${GREEN}✓ Set:${NC} $key"
        fi
    done < <(grep -v '^#' "$env_file" | grep -v '^$')

    echo
    # Report results
    if [ ${#missing_vars[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
        echo -e "${RED}=== Validation Failed ===${NC}"
        echo -e "${RED}The following required environment variables are not set:${NC}"
        for var in "${missing_vars[@]}"; do
            echo "  - $var"
        done
        echo
        echo "Please set values for all required environment variables in '$env_file'"
        exit 1
    else
        echo -e "${GREEN}=== Validation Passed ===${NC}"
        echo "All required environment variables are set."
        echo
    fi
}

# Send config to deployment orchestrator for audit compliance
send_config_to_orchestrator() {
    local env_file=".env.test"
    local json_payload="{\"timestamp\":\"$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)\",\"environment\":\"test\",\"config\":{"

    echo -e "${BLUE}=== Audit Compliance ===${NC}"
    echo "Sending config to deployment orchestrator..."
    echo -e "${YELLOW}URL:${NC} $ORCHESTRATOR_URL"
    echo

    local first=1

    # Parse .env.test and build JSON
    while IFS='=' read -r key value || [ -n "$key" ]; do
        # Skip empty lines, comments, and export statements
        [[ -z "$key" || "$key" == \#* || "$key" == export* ]] && continue

        # Trim whitespace
        key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
        value=$(echo "$value" | xargs)

        # Remove surrounding quotes if present
        value="${value%\"}"
        value="${value#\"}"
        value="${value%\'}"
        value="${value#\'}"

        # Escape special characters for JSON
        value=$(echo "$value" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g; s/"/\\"/g; s/\t/\\t/g; s/\r/\\r/g; s/\n/\\n/g')

        # Add comma separator if not first item
        if [ $first -eq 0 ]; then
            json_payload="${json_payload},"
        fi
        first=0

        # Add key-value pair to JSON
        json_payload="${json_payload}\"${key}\":\"${value}\""
    done < <(grep -v '^#' "$env_file" | grep -v '^$')

    json_payload="${json_payload}}}"

    echo -e "${YELLOW}Sending payload:${NC}"
    echo "$json_payload" | head -c 200
    if [ ${#json_payload} -gt 200 ]; then
        echo "..."
    else
        echo
    fi
    echo

    # Send POST request using curl (with fallbacks)
    local http_code=""
    local response=""

    if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        response=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" -X POST \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -H "X-Deployment-Timestamp: $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
            -d "$json_payload" \
            "$ORCHESTRATOR_URL" 2>&1) || true
        http_code=$(echo "$response" | tail -n1)
        response=$(echo "$response" | head -n -1)
    elif command -v wget >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        response=$(wget --timeout=10 --tries=3 -qO- \
            --header="Content-Type: application/json" \
            --header="X-Deployment-Timestamp: $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
            --post-data="$json_payload" \
            "$ORCHESTRATOR_URL" 2>&1) || true
        http_code="unknown"
    else
        echo -e "${YELLOW}⚠ Warning:${NC} Neither curl nor wget available"
        echo -e "${YELLOW}Config not sent to orchestrator for audit compliance${NC}"
        return 0
    fi

    # Check response
    if [[ "$http_code" =~ ^2[0-9]{2}$ ]]; then
        echo -e "${GREEN}✓ Config sent successfully${NC}"
        echo -e "${GREEN}✓ HTTP Status:${NC} $http_code"
        echo -e "${GREEN}✓ Audit logged${NC}"
        echo
        return 0
    elif [ "$http_code" = "000" ]; then
        echo -e "${YELLOW}⚠ Warning:${NC} Could not connect to orchestrator"
        echo -e "${YELLOW}  Config will not be audited${NC}"
        echo -e "${YELLOW}  Continuing with deployment...${NC}"
        echo
        return 0
    else
        echo -e "${RED}✗ Error:${NC} Failed to send config to orchestrator"
        echo -e "${RED}  HTTP Status:${NC} $http_code"
        if [ -n "$response" ]; then
            echo -e "${RED}  Response:${NC} $response"
        fi
        echo
        read -p "Continue with deployment anyway? (y/N) " -n 1 -r
        echo
        if [[ ! $REPLY =~ ^[Yy]$ ]]; then
            echo -e "${RED}Deployment cancelled${NC}"
            exit 1
        fi
        return 0
    fi
}

# Run pre-deployment validation
validate_environment_variables

# Send config to orchestrator for audit compliance
send_config_to_orchestrator

echo -e "${GREEN}=== Deployment Script ===${NC}"
echo "Creating release archive..."
echo

# Files and directories to exclude
EXCLUDE_PATTERNS=(
    "node_modules"
    ".git"
    ".gitignore"
    "*.log"
    ".env.local"
    ".env.development"
    ".env.production"
    "coverage"
    "*.tar.gz"
    ".DS_Store"
    "*.swp"
    "*.swo"
    "*~"
)

# Build the tar exclude arguments
EXCLUDE_ARGS=""
for pattern in "${EXCLUDE_PATTERNS[@]}"; do
    EXCLUDE_ARGS="$EXCLUDE_ARGS --exclude='$pattern'"
done

# Create the archive
echo -e "${YELLOW}Archiving:${NC} $ARCHIVE_NAME"
echo -e "${YELLOW}Exclude patterns:${NC} ${EXCLUDE_PATTERNS[*]}"
echo

# Use eval to properly handle the exclude arguments
eval "tar -czf '$ARCHIVE_NAME' $EXCLUDE_ARGS -C '$SCRIPT_DIR' ."

# Verify the archive was created
if [ -f "$ARCHIVE_NAME" ]; then
    ARCHIVE_SIZE=$(du -h "$ARCHIVE_NAME" | cut -f1)
    echo -e "${GREEN}✓ Success!${NC} Archive created: $ARCHIVE_NAME"
    echo -e "${GREEN}✓ Size:${NC} $ARCHIVE_SIZE"
    echo
    echo "To deploy this archive, you can use:"
    echo "  scp $ARCHIVE_NAME user@host:/path/to/deployment/"
else
    echo -e "${RED}✗ Error:${NC} Failed to create archive"
    exit 1
fi

#!/bin/bash

# Deployment Script
# Creates a release archive (tar.gz) of the current directory
# Excludes: node_modules, .git

set -e  # Exit on any error

# Configuration
SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
PROJECT_NAME="$(basename "$SCRIPT_DIR")"
TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
ARCHIVE_NAME="${PROJECT_NAME}_${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"
ENV_FILE=".env.test"

# Colors for output
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
RED='\033[0;31m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

echo -e "${YELLOW}Starting deployment...${NC}"

# =============================================
# Pre-deployment Validation
# =============================================
validate_env_vars() {
    echo -e "${YELLOW}Validating environment variables...${NC}"
    echo ""

    # Check if .env.test file exists
    if [ ! -f "$ENV_FILE" ]; then
        echo -e "${RED}Error: $ENV_FILE file not found!${NC}"
        echo "Please create $ENV_FILE with your required environment variables."
        exit 1
    fi

    # Read the env file and validate each variable
    local missing_vars=()
    local empty_vars=()
    local total_vars=0
    local valid_vars=0

    while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        if [[ -z "$line" || "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
            continue
        fi

        # Extract variable name (everything before =)
        local var_name=$(echo "$line" | cut -d'=' -f1)

        # Skip lines without assignment
        if [ -z "$var_name" ]; then
            continue
        fi

 # Check if variable has a value
        if [[ "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*"$var_name"=[[:space:]]*$ ]]; then
            # Variable exists but has no value (empty or whitespace only)
            empty_vars+=("$var_name")
            echo -e "  ${RED}✗${NC} $var_name = (empty)"
        elif [[ "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*"$var_name"=[[:space:]]*[\"']?[\"']?[[:space:]]*$ ]]; then
            # Variable has quotes but no value
            empty_vars+=("$var_name")
            echo -e "  ${RED}✗${NC} $var_name = (empty)"
        else
            # Variable has a value - check it's not empty string
            local var_value=$(echo "$line" | cut -d'=' -f2-)
            # Remove surrounding quotes
            var_value=$(echo "$var_value" | sed -e 's/^[[:space:]]*//' -e 's/[[:space:]]*$//' -e "s/^'//" -e "s/'$//" -e '^s/"//' -e 's/"$//')

            if [ -z "$var_value" ]; then

                # Mask sensitive values for display
                local masked_value
                if [[ "$var_name" =~ (PASSWORD|SECRET|KEY|TOKEN|API|PRIVATE) ]]; then
                    masked_value="***hidden***"
                else
                    masked_value="$var_value"
                fi
                echo -e "  ${GREEN}✓${NC} $var_name = $masked_value"
                ((valid_vars++))
            fi
        fi
        ((total_vars++))
    done < "$ENV_FILE"

    echo ""
    echo "Validation Summary:"
    echo "  Total variables found: $total_vars"
    echo -e "  ${GREEN}Valid variables: $valid_vars${NC}"

        echo -e "${RED}Error: The following environment variables are empty:${NC}"

        done
        echo ""
        echo "Please set values for all required environment variables in $ENV_FILE"
        exit 1
    fi

    echo ""
    echo -e "${GREEN}✓ All environment variables are properly set${NC}"
}

# Deployment script - Creates a release archive of the current directory
# Excludes: node_modules, .git, and the archive file itself

    "node_modules"
    ".git"
    "*.tar.gz"
)

    echo ""
    echo "To extract: tar -xzf $ARCHIVE_NAME"

    exit 1

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Mock deployment orchestrator server for testing"""

from http.server import HTTPServer, BaseHTTPRequestHandler
import json
from datetime import datetime

class OrchestratorHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_POST(self):
        if self.path == '/api/deploy-config':
            # Get content length
            content_length = int(self.headers.get('Content-Length', 0))
            body = self.rfile.read(content_length).decode('utf-8')

            try:
                config = json.loads(body)
                audit_id = f"AUD-{datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d%H%M%S')}"

                # Log the received config
                print(f"\n{'='*60}")
                print(f"[{datetime.now()}] Deployment Config Received")
                print(f"{'='*60}")
                print(f"Audit ID: {audit_id}")
                print(f"Hostname: {config.get('_hostname', 'N/A')}")
                print(f"Archive: {config.get('_archive', 'N/A')}")
                print(f"Timestamp: {config.get('_timestamp', 'N/A')}")
                print(f"\nEnvironment Variables:")
                for key, value in config.items():
                    if not key.startswith('_'):
                        print(f"  {key} = {value}")
                print(f"{'='*60}\n")

                # Send success response
                response = {
                    "status": "success",
                    "message": "Configuration received and logged for audit",
                    "audit_id": audit_id,
                    "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat()
                }

                self.send_response(200)
                self.send_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
                self.end_headers()
                self.wfile.write(json.dumps(response).encode('utf-8'))

            except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
                self.send_response(400)
                self.send_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
                self.end_headers()
                self.wfile.write(json.dumps({"error": f"Invalid JSON: {str(e)}"}).encode('utf-8'))
        else:
            self.send_response(404)
            self.end_headers()

    def log_message(self, format, *args):
        # Suppress default logging
        pass

if __name__ == '__main__':
    server = HTTPServer(('localhost', 47301), OrchestratorHandler)
    print("Mock deployment orchestrator running on http://localhost:47301")
    print("Press Ctrl+C to stop\n")
    try:
        server.serve_forever()
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        print("\nShutting down...")
        server.shutdown()

#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script - Creates a release archive of the current directory
# Excludes: node_modules, .git, and the archive file itself

set -e  # Exit on error

# Configuration
SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
ARCHIVE_NAME="release-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).tar.gz"
ORCHESTRATOR_URL="http://localhost:47301/api/deploy-config"
EXCLUDE_PATTERNS=(
    "node_modules"
    ".git"
    "*.tar.gz"
    ".env.test"
)

echo "========================================="
echo "Deployment Script"
echo "========================================="
echo "Working directory: $SCRIPT_DIR"
echo "Archive name: $ARCHIVE_NAME"
echo ""

# ==========================================
# Pre-deployment validation
# ==========================================

ENV_FILE=".env.test"

if [ ! -f "$ENV_FILE" ]; then
    echo "✗ Error: Environment file '$ENV_FILE' not found"
    exit 1
fi

echo "Step 1/3: Validating environment variables..."
echo "  Reading from: $ENV_FILE"

VALIDATION_ERRORS=0

# Read and validate each environment variable
while IFS='=' read -r key value || [[ -n "$key" ]]; do
    # Skip empty lines and comments
    if [[ -z "$key" || "$key" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# || "$key" =~ ^[[:space:]]*$ ]]; then
        continue
    fi

    # Trim whitespace from key
    key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)

    # Check if value is empty or just whitespace
    if [[ -z "$value" || "$value" =~ ^[[:space:]]*$ ]]; then
        echo "  ✗ Missing value for: $key"
        VALIDATION_ERRORS=$((VALIDATION_ERRORS + 1))
    else
        # Trim whitespace from value for display
        display_value=$(echo "$value" | xargs)
        # Mask sensitive values (common patterns)
        if [[ "$key" =~ (KEY|SECRET|PASSWORD|TOKEN|API) ]]; then
            display_value="***masked***"
        fi
        echo "  ✓ $key=$display_value"
    fi
done < "$ENV_FILE"

echo ""

if [ $VALIDATION_ERRORS -gt 0 ]; then
    echo "✗ Validation failed: $VALIDATION_ERRORS environment variable(s) missing values"
    echo "  Please update '$ENV_FILE' before deploying"
    exit 1
fi

echo "✓ Environment validation passed"
echo ""

# ==========================================
# Send config to orchestrator (Step 2/3)
# ==========================================

echo "Step 2/3: Sending configuration to deployment orchestrator..."
echo "  Endpoint: $ORCHESTRATOR_URL"

# Build JSON payload from env file
JSON_PAYLOAD="{"
FIRST_ENTRY=true

while IFS='=' read -r key value || [[ -n "$key" ]]; do
    # Skip empty lines and comments (including inline comments after trimming)
    if [[ -z "$key" || "$key" =~ ^[[:space:]]*$ ]]; then
        continue
    fi
    key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
    if [[ "$key" =~ ^# ]]; then
        continue
    fi
        continue
    fi

    # Trim whitespace
    key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
    value=$(echo "$value" | xargs)

    # Skip empty values (already validated, but being safe)
    if [[ -z "$value" ]]; then
        continue
    fi

    # Escape JSON special characters in key and value
    # Escape backslashes first, then double quotes
    escaped_key=$(echo "$key" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g' | sed 's/"/\\"/g')
    escaped_value=$(echo "$value" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g' | sed 's/"/\\"/g')

    # Add comma separator if not first entry
    if [ "$FIRST_ENTRY" = true ]; then
        FIRST_ENTRY=false
    else
        JSON_PAYLOAD="$JSON_PAYLOAD,"
    fi

    JSON_PAYLOAD="$JSON_PAYLOAD\"$escaped_key\":\"$escaped_value\""
done < "$ENV_FILE"

JSON_PAYLOAD="$JSON_PAYLOAD,\"_timestamp\":\"$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")\""
JSON_PAYLOAD="$JSON_PAYLOAD,\"_hostname\":\"$(hostname)\""
JSON_PAYLOAD="$JSON_PAYLOAD,\"_archive\":\"$ARCHIVE_NAME\"}"

# Send to orchestrator
HTTP_RESPONSE=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" -X POST \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -H "X-Deployment-Source: deploy.sh" \
    -d "$JSON_PAYLOAD" \
    "$ORCHESTRATOR_URL" 2>&1)

# Extract HTTP status code (last line)
HTTP_STATUS=$(echo "$HTTP_RESPONSE" | tail -n1)
# Extract response body
HTTP_BODY=$(echo "$HTTP_RESPONSE" | sed '$d')

if [ "$HTTP_STATUS" != "200" ] && [ "$HTTP_STATUS" != "201" ]; then
    echo "✗ Failed to send config to orchestrator"
    echo "  HTTP Status: $HTTP_STATUS"
    echo "  Response: $HTTP_BODY"
    exit 1
fi

echo "✓ Configuration sent to orchestrator"
echo "  Audit ID: $(echo "$HTTP_BODY" | grep -o '"id":"[^"]*"' | cut -d'"' -f4 2>/dev/null || echo 'N/A')"
echo ""

# ==========================================
# Create archive (Step 3/3)
# ==========================================

# Build the exclude arguments for tar
EXCLUDE_ARGS=""
for pattern in "${EXCLUDE_PATTERNS[@]}"; do
    EXCLUDE_ARGS="$EXCLUDE_ARGS --exclude='$pattern'"
done

# Create the archive
echo "Step 3/3: Creating release archive..."
eval "tar --ignore-failed-read -czf '$ARCHIVE_NAME' $EXCLUDE_ARGS -C '$SCRIPT_DIR' ."

# Check if archive was created successfully
if [ -f "$ARCHIVE_NAME" ]; then
    ARCHIVE_SIZE=$(du -h "$ARCHIVE_NAME" | cut -f1)
    echo "✓ Archive created successfully: $ARCHIVE_NAME"
    echo "  Size: $ARCHIVE_SIZE"
    echo ""
    echo "To extract: tar -xzf $ARCHIVE_NAME"
else
    echo "✗ Error: Archive creation failed"
    exit 1
fi

echo "========================================="
echo "Deployment complete!"
echo "========================================="
